title_en: Technology and Engineering (8/20): A Tense Debugging Session
note_en: 却 (què) means "but, yet," but unlike English "but" it can't start a clause; it goes after the subject (if there is one) and right before the verb: 他一遍又一遍地检查代码，却始终找不到问题的根源 "He checked the code over and over, but still couldn't find the root of the problem." It adds a note of surprise or frustration that things didn't turn out as expected.
